decision.first_slice: Fix patch receipt filtering, normalize package-lock public registry URLs, ignore generated UI outputs, and prove with npm install/typecheck/build, conformance tests, repo checks, and clean generated-output status.
decision.rationale: Both independent advisors support proceeding because receipt filtering, lockfile reproducibility, and generated-output cleanliness are necessary parts of the same first-run contributor outcome. No conflicts were raised.
